scope: symbolic checks of displayed finite-response formulas and a toy feedback linearization; no native simulation

first_evaluation.code: Clear[p,pt,p0,pp,t,h,s,tau,r]; p[t_] := pp + (p0-pp) Exp[-t/tau]; j[q_,a_] := r (pp a + (q-pp) tau (1-Exp[-a/tau])); <|"moment_residual" -> FullSimplify[Integrate[r p[t],{t,0,h},Assumptions->tau>0&&h>=0]-j[p0,h],tau>0&&h>=0], "subdivision_residual" -> FullSimplify[j[p0,s]+j[p[s],h-s]-j[p0,h],tau>0&&0<=s<=h], "midpoint_difference" -> FullSimplify[2(1-Exp[-1])-(2-Exp[-1/2]-Exp[-3/2])], "midpoint_positive_form_residual" -> FullSimplify[2(1-Exp[-1])-(2-Exp[-1/2]-Exp[-3/2])-2 Exp[-1](Cosh[1/2]-1)], "true_moment" -> Integrate[1-Exp[-t],{t,0,2}], "numerics" -> N[{1+Exp[-2],2-Exp[-1/2]-Exp[-3/2],2-2Exp[-1]},16], "series_midpoint_error" -> Series[j[p0,h]-r h p[h/2],{h,0,4}]|>

content.text: Out[1]= <|"damped_characteristic_polynomial" -> (k - gamma*kn + s + k*s*tau + s^2*tau)/tau, "damped_determinant" -> (k - gamma*kn)/tau, "nonlinear_consumer_uniform_residual" -> -1/6*((3 - Sqrt[3])*(-1 + (3 - Sqrt[3])/6)*(1/2 + (-3 + Sqrt[3])/6)), "latent_reconstruction_cubic_difference" -> 1/32|>
